claim: The second source check in approve omitted the canonical records directory.
evidence: The scoped check returned no errors while the unscoped check reported every JSON record as an unlisted worktree change.
impact: L3 approval could not complete with valid uncommitted canonical records.
required_action: Pass records_dir to every approval source check and test approval with an actual in-repository records set.

prevention.action: Keep records scope through approval and exempt only the exact records lock file.
